title: Publish terms
description: The names the publish lint flags in public copy, owned by the function that writes the words (EE-214): marketing-and-sales. It holds names only, never severities and never waivers, so the role that owns the copy can tighten the gate on itself without reaching naive.config.json, which can loosen it. A mark is another company's name, matched case-insensitively and on whole words; a mark marked private is a name the venture never makes public, and it is an error whatever level naive.config.json gives the marks rule. Severities and waivers stay a prior the venture sets under publish_lint in naive.config.json.

by.description: The role or person that last wrote the list

name.description: The name to flag, matched case-insensitively on whole words

private.description: The venture never makes this name public: a line that carries it is an error, not a warning

until.description: For a private name: what lifts it, such as the announcement
